company: Amazon Web Services, Inc. (a subsidiary of Amazon.com, Inc.)

ownership.quote: AWS Fargate is a serverless compute engine for containers that works with both Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS) and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS).

stage.quote: AWS segment sales increased 19% year-over-year to $107.6 billion.
stage.note: AWS Fargate is a service within Amazon Web Services, a business segment of the publicly traded Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN). It is not independently funded; no separate funding rounds exist for Fargate or AWS.

revenue.basis: Amazon.com, Inc. consolidated full-year 2024 net sales; AWS segment (which includes Fargate) net sales were $107.6 billion for 2024. Fargate's own product-level revenue is not separately disclosed.
revenue.quote: Net sales increased 11% to $638.0 billion in 2024, compared with $574.8 billion in 2023. ... AWS segment sales increased 19% year-over-year to $107.6 billion.

note: AWS Fargate is a serverless container-compute product within Amazon Web Services, itself a segment of the publicly traded parent company Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ: AMZN). It has no independent funding history, accelerator participation, or standalone revenue disclosure; figures reported here are for AWS as a whole (2024 segment net sales $107.6B) and for Amazon.com as a whole (2024 consolidated net sales $638.0B).
